name: Hungry Ghost Monk
summary: A predatory mystic who knocks foes aside and steals their ki, vitality, and spiritual resilience.

features.name: Punishing Kick
features.summary: Gain Punishing Kick without meeting its prerequisites; its push distance improves at 10th, 15th, and 20th level.
features.scaling: 5 feet; +5 feet at 10th and every 5 levels

features.name: Steal Ki
features.summary: On a confirmed critical hit or when reducing a living enemy to 0 hit points, replenish 1 spent ki point; at 11th level you may also retry a disease save.

features.name: Life Funnel
features.summary: On the same triggers as Steal Ki, heal hit points equal to Monk level instead of recovering ki.

features.name: Life from a Stone
features.summary: Steal ki or life force from any creature rather than only living creatures.

features.name: Sipping Demon
features.summary: While at least 1 ki remains, gain temporary hit points from melee hits and additional temporary hit points on critical hits, up to Monk level.
